mechanism_builds.causal_path: Higher baseline HRV -> increased temporal autocorrelation of conformity scores -> violation of exchangeability assumption -> Mondrian quantile underestimates needed width -> narrower intervals -> lower empirical coverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Increase in baseline HRV leads to decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: resting baseline period >=5 min before stress
ECG sampling rate >=130 Hz
stress labels defined as per WESAD protocol
measurable_outcomes: Ljung-Box test p-value for residual autocorrelation
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Require baseline HRV computed from first 5 min of each subject's ECG; compute conformity scores on calibration set; test exchangeability via runs test.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Greater motion artifact -> increased local variance of sensor signals -> homoscedasticity assumption violated -> quantile underestimates needed width for high-variance periods -> intervals too narrow -> lower empirical coverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Increase in accelerometer high-frequency RMS leads to decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: periods subject is ambulatory or performing tasks
sampling rate >=32 Hz for accelerometer
sensor firmly attached
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Label motion artifact using accelerometer magnitude > threshold; compute local variance in sliding windows; compare coverage across low vs high artifact windows.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: As recording progresses, habituation reduces physiological response -> true stress label distribution shifts -> calibration based on early data misrepresents later -> conformity scores biased -> intervals too narrow -> lower empirical coverage for later segments
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Later time -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: stress episodes occurring after >10 min from start
baseline physiological state stable before each episode
labels derived from self-report and video annotation
measurable_outcomes: average prediction interval width per bin
Kolmogorov-Smirnov test p-value between early and late residuals
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Split data into early (first half) and late (second half) segments; compute coverage separately; test for distributional shift.

mechanism_variables: timestamp offset between ECG and respiration (ms)
cross-correlation lag at max mutual information
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Misaligned timestamps -> spurious feature correlations -> model overconfident -> residuals shrunk -> prediction intervals too narrow -> lower empirical coverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Larger absolute offset -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)

segments where both signals present
sampling rate >=130 Hz for ECG, >=70 Hz for respiration
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Estimate offset by maximizing mutual information between ECG-derived features and respiration features; evaluate coverage as function of estimated offset.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Noisy labels -> observed conformity scores inflated (model penalized for mismatched labels) -> quantile underestimates true uncertainty -> intervals too narrow -> lower empirical coverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Higher label noise entropy -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: periods where annotators disagree on stress label
labels derived from self-report, video, and expert review
minimum of two independent annotators
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: If multiple labels unavailable, simulate label noise by flipping a proportion of labels according to estimated error rate.

mechanism_variables: subject baseline arousal (mean skin conductance level)

mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Lower baseline arousal -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction) when using high-intensity stratum
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: baseline measured during 5-min resting period before each stress episode
stress intensity defined by self-report Likert scale
sampling rates sufficient for GSR

mechanism_variables: number of calibration samples per subject

mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Decrease in calibration size -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)

minimum of 10 samples required for stable quantile
same scoring function applied across subjects
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Use bootstrap to estimate quantile variance; compare coverage across subjects with calibration size above vs below threshold.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Missing non-linear interaction -> model mis-specifies relationship -> residuals larger for subjects with strong coupling but not captured -> conformity scores miscalibrated -> intervals too narrow -> lower empirical coverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Stronger GSR-temperature interaction (higher product) -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: periods where both GSR and temperature vary (e.g., during stress)
sampling rate >=4 Hz for GSR, >=4 Hz for temperature
sensor placement on same hand
measurable_outcomes: significance of interaction term in augmented model

mechanism_variables: physiological response slope (e.g., HRV change per stress unit)

mechanism_variables: feature bias (difference between true and windowed feature)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Short stress bouts -> window includes pre/post non-stress data -> feature values diluted -> model predicts less extreme -> conformity scores inflated -> intervals too narrow -> lower empirical coverage for short bouts
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Shorter bout length relative to window -> decrease in empirical coverage (negative direction)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: stress bouts defined by annotation epochs
fixed window length used for feature extraction (e.g., 10s)
sampling rate sufficient to capture dynamics within window
measurable_outcomes: empirical coverage for bouts < window length
empirical coverage for bouts >= window length
average prediction interval width per bout duration bin
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Vary window length in analysis; compute coverage as function of bout duration/window ratio; test for significant interaction.
